description: List every configured public Threat Intel source ID, name, format, surface and source URL from the pinned collector registry. Free; no user data, repositories, or credits. No arguments. Use the exact ID in ti_latest.source; guessed aliases are rejected. The complete bounded catalog is returned in one response. Registration does not guarantee live collection or records in a given window. On the account-free public endpoint, send calls sequentially. HTTP 429 means rate or concurrency admission was denied, not an empty result. Wait at least the HTTP Retry-After seconds before retrying the same read; use backoff with jitter for repeated rejections.
name: ti_sources
